name: NHS Wales — under-18 neurodevelopmental assessment pathway data standard
description: Digital Health and Care Wales notice defining national data collection for NHS Wales autism and ADHD neurodevelopmental assessment services for people under 18.
intended_use: Confirm the national Wales child neurodevelopmental assessment context and waiting/pathway measurement while using individual health-board sources for operational referral details.
audience_or_context: Families, supporters, researchers and professionals examining child and young-person autism/ADHD assessment in Wales.
limitations: This is a national data-standard notice, not a family-facing referral guide.
Operational referral rules and age/service boundaries remain health-board specific.
conflicts_of_interest: Digital Health and Care Wales defines reporting requirements for NHS Wales services; ND Oracle records the system context without assuming service performance.

provenance.method: Current 2026 NHS Wales under-18 autism/ADHD assessment data-provision notice checked on 2026-09-03 for national pathway scope and local-service distinction. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
